knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Burn-down means losing drive while still caring about the work, so it can slip past unnoticed longer than burnout does.
A goal with a date and a measure can be checked. Vague or unreviewed goals cannot.
Sharing routine decisions and planning time away protect the leader's capacity over time.

practicalCriteria: The learner writes a personal development plan with at least two weaknesses turned into dated goals, each with a measure.
The learner names a mentor, a check-in schedule and a planned time away with a named cover person.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and hand over duties if the leader is too fatigued to work safely, and inform the supervisor.
Stop and refer any case where the leader's workload is causing missed safety checks.
